Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: privacy-policy
Version: 1.0.1

The Privacy Policy Generator is a legitimate utility for creating privacy policy templates (Standard, GDPR, and CCPA). The core logic in `scripts/privacy.sh` uses standard bash practices to populate text templates with user-provided arguments and contains no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or unauthorized network activity.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward privacy-policy template generator and the visible code matches that purpose, but the scripts/privacy.sh file in the manifest was truncated so we couldn't review the entire script. Before installing or running: (1) request the full scripts/privacy.sh and verify there are no network calls, URL downloads, or commands that read system files or credentials; (2) run the script in a restricted sandbox first; (3) avoid entering real sensitive credentials or full datasets into the tool until you confirm it does not transmit data; and (4) remember generated policies are templates only — consult a qualified lawyer before relying on them for compliance.
llm.findings: [NO_SCAN_FINDINGS] expected: The static pre-scan reported no injection or regex findings. This is consistent with a simple, local template generator. HOWEVER, the bundled script shown in the manifest is truncated, so the scanner had less content to analyze and any hidden behavior in the remainder cannot be ruled out.
